title: Global Training
description: Wellcome Connecting Science Global Training lists capacity-building courses for research and healthcare communities in Latin America, Africa and Asia. Listed courses include computational, laboratory and genomic surveillance training events.
practicalUse: Public health genomics users can identify upcoming training opportunities for staff development in genomic sequencing, genome analysis and pathogen surveillance.
formatDetails: Training events website with course listings, dates, application information and event details.
legacyTags: Course offerings change over time; tagging reflects examples visible on the Global Training page.
